fastback.help.command.create-file-remote: Create a remote backup target on the file system.
fastback.help.command.enable: Enable local backups backups on this world.
fastback.help.command.full: Perform a local and remote backup immediately. Optional remark: up to 64 characters, including spaces; multiple languages supported.
fastback.help.command.gc: Run garbage collection to free up disk space.
fastback.help.command.info: Info about current backup state and settings.
fastback.help.command.init: Initialize fastback for the current world. Run this first.
fastback.help.command.list: List local snapshots, newest first, eight per page. Usage: /backup list [page]. Click arrows to change pages or an entry to copy its backup ID.
fastback.help.command.local: Perform a local backup immediately. Optional remark: up to 64 characters, including spaces; multiple languages supported.
fastback.help.command.view: View a local snapshot's ID, server-local date and time, creator, and remark. Usage: /backup view <backup-id>.
fastback.help.command.cancel: Cancel an ongoing backup or a snapshot load before the server starts stopping.
fastback.help.command.load: Show a local snapshot's details and click Confirm load to start its countdown. The dedicated server saves, backs up, loads the snapshot, and restarts automatically. Use /backup cancel during the countdown or preparation.
fastback.help.command.remote-load: Show a remote snapshot's details and click Confirm load to start its countdown. The dedicated server saves, backs up, loads the snapshot, and restarts automatically. Use /backup cancel during the countdown or preparation.
fastback.help.command.prune: Delete old snapshots according to the retention policy.
fastback.help.command.push: Push a snapshot to the remote.
fastback.help.command.remote-list: List remote snapshots, newest first, eight per page. Usage: /backup remote-list [page]. Click arrows to change pages or an entry to copy its backup ID.
fastback.help.command.remote-prune: Delete old snapshots from the remote backup according to the remote retention policy.
fastback.help.command.set-autoback-actio: Set an action to perform during auto-backups.
fastback.help.command.set-autoback-wait: Set the minimum number of minutes to wait between auto-backups.
fastback.help.command.set-remote: Set the url for remote backups.
fastback.help.command.set-remote-retenti: Set snapshot retention policy for the remote backup.
fastback.help.command.set-shutdown-actio: Set an action to perform on shutdown.
fastback.help.subcommands:
Available subcommands:
%s
For detailed help on a subcommand, run
/backup help [subcommand]
or go to https://pcal43.github.io/fastback

fastback.chat.remark-too-long: Remark must be at most %s characters, including spaces.
fastback.chat.load-countdown: The server will load snapshot %s in %s seconds. Use /backup cancel to cancel.
fastback.chat.load-waiting-preparation: Countdown finished; waiting for snapshot preparation. /backup cancel still works.
fastback.chat.cancel-requested: Cancellation requested. Waiting for the task to stop and clean up.
fastback.chat.cancel-none: No cancellable backup task or snapshot load is running.
fastback.chat.load-scheduled: Snapshot %s is ready. The server will stop, back up the current world, load the snapshot, and restart automatically. See the server log for the previous world's recovery path.
fastback.chat.load-stopping: The server is stopping to back up and load a snapshot. It will restart automatically; reconnect when it is ready.
fastback.chat.load-pending: A snapshot is already prepared for loading. The server is stopping; backup tasks are suspended.
fastback.chat.load-failed: Snapshot loading failed before shutdown. The current world has not been replaced. See the server log for details.
fastback.chat.retention-policy-not-set: No retention policy set.  Run /backup set retention-policy
fastback.chat.thread-busy: Another backup task is currently running.  Please wait for it to finish and try again.
fastback.chat.thread-waiting: Waiting for current backup tasks to complete...
fastback.broadcast.message: The server is starting a backup.
fastback.retain.fixed.description: Fixed: Keep only the %s most-recent snapshots.
fastback.retain.daily.description: Daily: Keep the last snapshot from each day, plus all snapshots from the last %s days
fastback.retain.gfs.description: GFS: Keep every backup today + latest daily backup in the last week + latest weekly backup in the last month + latest backup of each month
fastback.chat.load-warning: Saves the current world, replaces it and restarts the server.
